retrieval.title: Retrieval testing
retrieval.intro: Ask a question and see which passages of {{dataset}} the search returns, with their scores.

field.question: Question
field.questionPlaceholder: Type a question about this dataset's documents
field.thresholdHelp: Passages scoring below this are left out. Raise it to see fewer, closer matches.
field.weightHelp: Move toward vector to rank by meaning, toward keyword to rank by matching words.
field.rerankHelp: Reorders the closest passages with a dedicated model. Takes longer.

retrieval.stale: The settings changed after this result. Run the test again to update it.

results.title: Results
results.timingsRerank: Embedding {{embed}} ms · Search {{search}} ms · Rerank {{rerank}} ms

idle.heading: Run a test to see results
idle.body: Results show the passages the assistant would draw on, with keyword, vector and overall scores.

empty.heading: No passages matched
empty.body: Lower the similarity threshold, or try other words.

retrieval.noChunks: No document in this dataset has been parsed yet, so there is nothing to search.

error.model: This dataset's embedding model is no longer available in the workspace.
error.rerank: The rerank model isn't available right now. Choose No rerank, or try again in a moment.
error.index: The search index isn't available right now. Try again in a moment.
error.limited: The embedding provider is limiting requests. Wait a moment and try again.
error.timeout: The search took too long. Try again.
error.fallback: The test couldn't run. Try again.
